summary: Depots that can source/sink this job; no effect if the job has no pickup/delivery step.
businessRules: Only vehicles whose depots intersect the job's depot_ids can fulfill it.

depot_ids defines: Specify the depots which can be used to fulfil this job. In case of a pickup job, the assigned vehicle will deliver the goods to the depot specified here, at the end of its trip. Conversely, in cas…
Each element in depot_ids must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.start_depot_ids, vehicles.end_depot_ids. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: job depot_ids ["A"] served by a vehicle starting at A.
Infeasible: job depot_ids incompatible with any vehicle's depots -> unassigned.
Interaction: Positive: two depots north/south, demand split by region -> each vehicle serves its nearby cluster.
